newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian tax code not likely to work until '99 - Kokh.
newsitem.headline: Russian tax code not likely to work until '99 - Kokh.

text.p: Russia's new tax code will probably not come into effect until 1999, Deputy Prime Minister Alfred Kokh said on Thursday.
"There is the hope that it will be passed this year," he said of the code at a news conference. "But it is practically impossible that it will come into effect in 1998.
"We will try to take all measures to pass it in 1997, and in 1998 we will work out all the needed instructions, teach the tax payers and tax inspectors and from 1999 put the code into effect."

Some foreign investors and the International Monetary Fund say the tax code is instrumental to attracting foreign investment. It has four parts, some of which are still being worked on by the government.
